hypothesis.claim: On exact finite-coder replay over the frozen opening and distant Endpoint428 populations, a hierarchical sleeping Bayesian market over route-equivalent historical values produces a T payload that clears the frozen target-bearing parent margin, is positive in every independently terminated chronological third, repays each nested A-to-M-to-H-to-T package increment, and beats matched route, kernel, and physical-history controls while preserving exact HARM-A and P/K identity.
hypothesis.falsification: Do not authorize native T if any exactness, identity, causality, repeat, package, memory, runtime, thirdwise, distant-transfer, nested marginal, or matched-control predicate fails; retain only the simplest preceding arm whose own frozen predicates pass.

changedMechanism: Replace HARM-Delta's single latest exact-route donor with a nested, bounded market: eight exact-route ancestors, then route-shape and causal content-type backoff, then one frozen type-selected transformation kernel per donor, all under factorized sleeping Bayesian priors and independent exact finite coders.
invariants: The active Endpoint428 HORIZON experiment continues unchanged and no PALIMPSEST corpus replay reads its scientific outputs before terminal routing.
P is immutable Endpoint428 and K executes complete PALIMPSEST bookkeeping while sending exactly P to an independent finite coder.
A reproduces the frozen HARM-Delta latest exact-route generic edit probability and Q63 parent-mixture trajectory exactly.
M adds only exact-route ancestor ranks one through seven; H adds only route-shape and decoded-prefix content-type backoff; T adds only one typed leaf per unchanged H donor.

X preserves T geometry but permutes donor routes within power-of-two age and length buckets; C preserves T donors but changes every typed-kernel assignment; G preserves T geometry with exactly age-, content-type-, and length-matched physical-history donors.
Every candidate distribution, hierarchical weight, outer Q63 mixture probability, and finite-coder interval is computed before the current truth updates any state.
Current values enter all reservoirs only after field exit and every deferred decoded byte commit; overflowing values are not installed.
No route, source address, distance, length, edit script, transform choice, probability trace, descriptor tape, model, or dictionary is transmitted by the proposed mechanism.
Actual payload, framing, models, tables, source, and transmitted package material are counted as bytes; memory and runtime are separate hard gates and are never monetized into bytes.
Ideal log loss and block bootstrap summaries are descriptive only. Literal independently terminated payload bytes control every promotion predicate.
Separate PALIMPSEST, HORIZON, HARM, Fiber, or MIDAS gains are never added. Any composition requires a fresh joint probability trajectory and finite archive.

population.coordinate: Canonical raw pretruth coordinate binds scope and thirds; zero-based WRT byte plus MSB-first bit binds Endpoint428 probabilities, truths, and arithmetic decisions.
